scope_note: Residual synthesis after the Meta Prineville direct-evidence audit. One medium-confidence unit conversion carries Meta's rounded 2024 facility-level water-withdrawal observation from megaliters to gallons because the shared direct register has no compatible annual-withdrawal metric. The three low-confidence county benchmark comparisons were removed: even with fit-sensitivity envelopes and explicit non-causal labels, they do not materially improve decisions about this campus and remain vulnerable to concurrent Meta expansions, Apple's separate campus and unrelated county changes. No supplier, construction, payroll, household-spending, tax-abatement, public-service-cost or fiscal-net model is retained because local inputs and same-scope evidence are insufficient.

estimates.label: Unit-converted annual water withdrawal

interval.interpretation: The band reflects rounding of the source's displayed 328 megaliters to the nearest whole megaliter before conversion; it is not a confidence interval.

provenance.detail: Prineville 2024 water-withdrawal row on document page I
Exact unit-conversion factor used for presentation

estimates.confidence_rationale: The facility row and conversion are reproducible, but the published amount is rounded and its site-level measurement basis is not specified.
estimates.decision_relevance: Preserves the public facility-level water observation in a compatible presentation unit while the shared canonical direct-evidence metric is absent.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Canonical annual water-withdrawal metric, unrounded meter data, withdrawal source allocation, consumption, reuse, discharge and billing by facility

derivation.formula: reported Prineville water withdrawal in megaliters × 264,172.052 gallons per megaliter
assumptions: The displayed source value is rounded to the nearest whole megaliter.
The estimate must not be presented as observed, audited, source-reported or causal.

limitations: The source rounds to whole megaliters and permits meter, utility, design-estimate or proxy inputs where applicable.
Withdrawal is not consumption; no site-specific consumption or discharge value is reported.
The value is not an audited groundwater-meter or billing record and is not allocated to an individual campus building.
estimates.notes: Source-reported facility value carried as a visibly modeled unit conversion because no compatible canonical direct-evidence metric exists.
